note: Zoom on the play corner of the teal big-numbers room: cubby shelf under the big window, round blue rug, grey gym-line floor (cartoon style). Each item stands apart on the floor with its own shadow (no table), left to right: the feminine 'about-N' nouns on the left of the divider (la douzaine eggs doing Zen, la vingtaine toy blue van with a roof rack of marbles, la trentaine train wagon of beads); then quarante (carrots with an ant); then soixante (swan in sand), soixante-dix (swan and dice), quatre-vingts (cat with four toy vans), quatre-vingt-dix (cat with four vans and dice); le milliard (billiard rack, masculine) far right. The blank card on the wall is the sign.
